info.name: Atur Perjalanan API (M0–M5.1)
info.description:
# Cara pakai

1. Import collection ini + environment **Atur Perjalanan — Local**
2. Pilih environment **Atur Perjalanan — Local** (kanan atas Postman)
3. Isi `google_id_token_a` dari halaman login Google (akun Alice)
4. Jalankan folder **01 — Auth (User A)** berurutan
5. Isi `google_id_token_b` (akun Google lain), jalankan **02 — Auth (User B)**
6. Lanjut folder berikutnya secara berurutan

**Catatan:** Google ID token expired ~1 jam. App JWT (`token_a`/`token_b`) expired 24 jam — diisi otomatis oleh Tests script.

**M5.1:** Folder **10 — Notifications & Gaps** mencakup endpoint baru (check-username, notifications, tab filter, soft-delete message, privacy trips). Response enrichments (cover_image_url, participants_preview, embedded sender/inviter) divalidasi di folder 03–07.

**Prasyarat:** `make up && make migrate-up && make run`
